best_idea: The client keeps a non-authoritative mirror of tracked missions; the server pushes a full replace on login and single-mission upserts afterwards, and the client sends back only a capped selection, never a completion.
decision_why: A Frankendom quest tracker HUD needs the same mirror-and-push split with completion and rewards server-side; keep the full-replace vs upsert split and the capped selection, and drop the client hacks (forced-incomplete entry, timer guard, silent cap).
acceptance: A server test asserts that after a full push of two missions a track request for the 256th mission returns full and the payload carries 255 ids; an upsert changes one mission's text without reordering the list; a client mirror entry cannot mark a quest complete.
